domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

**Seat ruling, R7 scope (os-dev report open_questions[0], PR #33621): A.**

R1 covers all three askers: run end, the batch writer and single save each judge a layer as the served fold. R7 covers upgrades only, and an upgrade is a registration run. Single save and the batch writer keep main's answer, judging against the slot left empty, so an own body re-saved unchanged over a pair a cold boot admitted is still refused, as on main. No plumbing of the pre-batch contributor.

This narrows my ruling text above, which was ambiguous. It keeps main's behaviour on the save doors, so it moves no answer. Revisit only if a save door is reported refusing an unchanged body; that would be a new card.

On out_of_scope_findings: the registered entry `18.record-currency-follow-pair-refused-on-install-and-reload` stays as registered. The new entry states the R7 behaviour.
